source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD16A2GF.061 gap-filled 8-day evapotranspiration, tile h19v04 (LP DAAC)

confidence.note: Averaged over cropland pixels only (≥ 50 % ESA WorldCover 2021 'cropland' inside the pixel). Satellite-driven model (Penman–Monteith with MODIS vegetation); 8-day totals spread over the calendar days they cover.
